data.narrative:
Zeromark is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Joel Anderson that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $10M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. Peer-Median analysis examines four same-sector comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The median valuation across these peers is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulation produces a range of $21M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $362M. The wide dispersion reflects substantial heterogeneity in the peer set—particularly the $4.0B outlier (Stark Defence) versus the $125M floor. Key uncertainties include whether UFORCE's $1.0B seed valuation represents typical market pricing for this stage or an outlier, and whether Zeromark's specific technical or market position warrants positioning toward the peer median or the lower-bound stage-progression estimate. Further diligence on product maturity and customer validation would narrow this range.
